message.nojbput.disabled: Offhand interception is disabled by the server configuration
message.nojbput.none: Offhand interception is not available in the server configuration
gui.nojbput.config.title: No JB Put
gui.nojbput.config.syntax:
List syntax:
minecraft:torch - exact item id
minecraft:*_planks - wildcard, * = any length, ? = one char
create:* - every item of that mod
#minecraft:logs - item tag (all logs)
nojbput.configuration.title: %s Configuration
nojbput.configuration.section.tooltip: No JB Put intercepts offhand block placement and offhand item usage. All of these settings are server-authoritative.
nojbput.configuration.masterSwitch.toolt: When false the mod intercepts nothing and the inventory badge is hidden.
nojbput.configuration.disableOffhandPlac:
true: the cycle includes the states that block placement (green / blue / red).
false: placement blocking is unreachable and the cycle never shows blue.
nojbput.configuration.disableOffhandUsag:
true: the cycle includes the states that block usage (green / yellow / red).
false: usage blocking is unreachable and the cycle never shows yellow.
nojbput.configuration.mainHandList.toolt: Decides interception from the item held in the main hand.
nojbput.configuration.offHandList.toolti: Decides interception from the item held in the offhand.
nojbput.configuration.mode.tooltip:
WHITELIST: entries are an exception list.
BLACKLIST: entries are blocked.
An empty list disables this filter.
nojbput.configuration.items.tooltip:
One entry per line:
minecraft:torch - exact item id
minecraft:*_planks - wildcard, * = any length, ? = one char
create:* - every item of that mod
#minecraft:logs - item tag (all logs)
